notes.title: Badass Civil War Beards. Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
The first update is all about beards. Authentic facial hair inspired by Burnside, Jenkins & Grant - face enemy volleys in style!

Update 1.0.1:
Additions:
15 new beard styles. Muttonchops, goatees, long beards.
Skirmish game mode with 500 tickets. Quick battles.

Changes:
Thicker smoke to cloud the battlefield.
Reduced damage to bayonet attacks.

Fixes:
Fixed infantry death animations freezing.
Player reloading animations exiting correctly while walking.
Union lines sometimes not moving after attacks.
